protocols.description: List of protocols to enable. Must include 'sieve' for ManageSieve support.

managesieve_port.description: Port on which the ManageSieve service listens (plain text).

managesieve_ssl_port.description: Port for ManageSieve over SSL/TLS. Set to null to disable SSL listener.

managesieve_max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous ManageSieve client connections per process.

sieve_script_path.description: Path (relative to mail_root) where user-specific Sieve scripts are stored.

sieve_default_script.description: Name of the default script (without .sieve extension) to load for all users if no personal script exists.

sieve_global_dir.description: Directory for global scripts (e.g., post-delivery filters). Must be writable by dovecot user.

sieve_extensions.description: List of ManageSieve extensions to enable (e.g., fileinto, vacation, date).

sieve_before.description: List of global Sieve scripts run before user scripts (pre-filter).

sieve_after.description: List of global Sieve scripts run after user scripts (post-filter).

managesieve_logout_format.description: Format string for ManageSieve logout logging (variables: bytes in/out, time elapsed).

managesieve_ssl.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS for ManageSieve connections. Set 'yes', 'no', or 'required'.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file for ManageSieve connections.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file for ManageSieve connections.

ssl_min_protocol.description: Minimum SSL/TLS protocol version to allow (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

auth_mechanisms.description: Authentication mechanisms supported for ManageSieve login. Must match Dovecot auth config.
